config.world: D2v2's world with clouds on embedded manifolds added to the discovery families: an m-dimensional Gaussian in a random m-dimensional subspace of R^d with isotropic noise 0.01 (0.005 for the sheet; a noisier held-out subspace at 0.05 and two unseen manifolds at 0.02 and 0.002); a random smooth nonlinear embedding of an m-dimensional Gaussian (random Fourier features, 3d of them at bandwidth 0.5, 0.75 or 1.0, a Gaussian readout) with noise; a product of m circles read through the first four harmonics of each angle (three for the unseen torus), a curved m-manifold of spectral dimension near 8m; a two-dimensional swiss-roll sheet; intrinsic dimension m on 4, 8, 16, ambient d on 64, 128. Observers C = diag(i^-alpha) R as before. Held-out worlds include manifolds at unseen m and d; unseen families, real corpora and scale cells on the run seed only, against the law frozen at the pilot; the frozen D2 and D2v2 laws carried as competitors.
